title: E1 — cost of canonicalize, name, sign and verify by payload size (Node)
description: Wall-clock time of one call of canonicalizeArgs, makeName, signData and verifyData from @idem/core, for payloads from 1 KiB to 1 MiB. The payload is the `text` argument for canonicalizeArgs and makeName, and the result text for signData and verifyData. Each cell: untimed warm-up, then one timed call per iteration with performance.now(). The whole run is repeated and every repetition is kept.
